method.stored_tier: prediction registered in the feedback store before the event (no look-ahead by construction)
method.replay_tier: production AI prompt re-run on news with published_at <= event (ledger rows additionally require observed_at <= event); non-reconstructable inputs left absent
method.ground_truth: realized signed gap move settled by the feedback pipeline (~36h after the report)
caveats: llm_training_knowledge: the replay model may know post-event results for well-known tickers from its training data; treat replay verdicts as indicative, not as proof of point-in-time accuracy
analyst_eps_retail_gap_absent: analyst consensus, EPS beat history, eToro retail and gap risk are not reconstructable as-of the event and were left absent from the replay prompt (rendered N/A)
news_rotation: events whose pre-event news rotated out of the stores run without news evidence and are reported as abstentions, not drops
